U.note: Bold dark tin-themed design with a tidy bento popover, but the popover overlaps hero text and the closed state shows no bento at all.

V.note: Bento panel with quantity stepper works but opens narrow, covers page copy awkwardly, and the 'Nothing selected yet' state is clunky.

W.note: Rich bento menu with roast chips, sliders, toggles and accordions, though the tiny type is dense and the toast overlaps the headline.

X.note: Functional small bento with roast, grind and quantity controls, but plain, sparse and the bento sits in an unstyled page.

Y.note: Clean dark-pill nav opening a well-composed bento with subscription and guides, a bit generic and small in text.

Z.note: Strongest bento: colorful tiles collapse to an icon strip and expand into a rich illustrated grid, with state readout and keyboard hints.
